people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus came to them and spoke to them, saying, “All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth.
translations.bsb: Then Jesus came to them and said, “All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to Me.
translations.kjv: And Jesus came and spake unto them, saying, All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.
translations.asv: And Jesus came to them and spake unto them, saying, All authority hath been given unto me in heaven and on earth.
